name: ravenhogwarts-toolkit
description: A personal toolkit plugin (OTK) that integrates various Obsidian utilities, designed to enhance personal note-taking experience.

scripts.dev: node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/deploy.mjs link && node scripts/esbuild.config.mjs dev
scripts.build: tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node scripts/esbuild.config.mjs prod && node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/deploy.mjs copy
scripts.version: pnpm run build && node scripts/version-bump.mjs && pnpm i

author: RavenHogWarts
